scope: Task/reward/DZ/version reservations only; NPCowner owns NPC/spawn/lootnumericnamespace checks. Existingversion_spawns checked only asversionoccupancy, no fullNPCaudit. No playerrows queried.

tasks.query: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=920136 OR title='Scent of a Woman' OR replay_timer_group=920136 OR request_timer_group=920136 OR dz_template_id=920136

reward_option_entries.query: SELECT * FROM reward_option_entries WHERE reward_set_id=920136 OR reward_id IN (3839201361,3839201362,3839201363,3839201364,3839201365,3839201366)

reward_sources.query: SELECT * FROM reward_sources WHERE reward_set_id=920136 OR(source_type=2 AND source_id=920136)

reward_source_entries.query: SELECT * FROM reward_source_entries WHERE(source_type=2 AND source_id=920136) OR reward_id IN (3839201361,3839201362,3839201363,3839201364,3839201365,3839201366)

dynamic_zone_templates.query: SELECT * FROM dynamic_zone_templates WHERE id=920136 OR(zone_id=482 AND zone_version=1)

zone_version.query: SELECT zoneidnumber,short_name,version,long_name FROM zone WHERE zoneidnumber=482 AND version=1

version_spawns.query: SELECT id,spawngroupID FROM spawn2 WHERE zone='underquarry' AND version=1

version_instances.query: SELECT id,zone,version FROM instance_list WHERE zone=482 AND version=1

active_dynamic_zone_instances.query: SELECT dz.id,dz.instance_id,il.zone,il.version FROM dynamic_zones dz JOIN instance_list il ON il.id=dz.instance_id WHERE il.zone=482 AND il.version=1
